answer: Copying an answer as a result yields nothing, and producing 155 genuinely distinct answers per epoch is real inference work with real latency; the anchor ledger keeps the similarity graph, and the dawn review can re-run it. A near-duplicate is rejected at the harbor gate and the submitting identity is flagged, so one good text cannot be reused across aliases. Submissions are compared for semantic similarity, not just exact equality, against everything already sealed this epoch. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
